Essay Topics on Cheap Air Travelling 
1. Advantages & Disadvantages (Most Common IELTS Type) 
Cheap air travelling has made international travel affordable for 
millions of people. 
What are the advantages and disadvantages of this development? 
 
2. Opinion Essay 
Some people believe that cheap air travelling brings more benefits 
than drawbacks, while others argue it causes serious environmental 
and social problems. 
To what extent do you agree or disagree? 
 
3. Problem–Solution Essay 
The rapid growth of cheap air travelling has led to environmental 
damage and overcrowded airports. 
What problems does this cause, and what measures can be taken to 
address them?
